item.description:
• Search files from the launcher, and keep a shortcut to what it found
  • Show files for what you typed, not for a prefix you had to know
  • Ask the index a question it can seek, not one it must scan
  • Stop deleting a launcher provider's answer one tick before showing it
  • Keep room for file rows in a list already full of apps
  • Give contact rows the Contacts icon they were asking for
  • Put the obvious file first
  • Let the files you open climb the file search
  • Answer the query on screen, not the one three keystrokes ago
  • Rank a file the same way as everything else it competes with
  • Drop a mute scope check nobody read
  • Put the folder at the top of the disk at the top of the list
  • Find the folders Spotlight refuses to admit exist
  • Reach any folder by a few letters per level, or none at all
  • List home for a bare tilde and let a space match no space
  • Weigh the ranking signals instead of tiering them
  • Let what gets picked climb, and show files as Finder draws them
  • Never dress up one query's rows as another's, and heal lost answers
  • Keep the arrowed-to row selected when late results land
  • Open .html files instead of refusing them as the default browser
• Hand the window server the whole corner curve, at its own scale

• Put the launcher hairline on the edge it is tracing
  • Write down the http timeout that already exists
  • Tell plugin authors what an unattended tick does when it throws
  • Say the plugin docs' points once instead of arguing them

• Stop an unreadable fan maximum from reading as full speed
  • Read the agent template from a file instead of a Swift literal
  • Delete APIs and config that nothing reads
  • Delete docs describing work that already shipped
  • Add the helpers the modules have each been writing privately
  • Route the modules through the shared helpers
  • Stop hand-rolling what SwiftUI and AppKit already do
  • Say each thing the tests check once
  • Add an emoji picker that reads the emoji list macOS already ships
  • Keep the display awake, not just the machine
  • Let the emoji panel ask for its rows
  • Add a color blindness simulator built on a frozen screenshot
  • List the two new plugins among the ones with no legacy name
  • Hold a panel message until there is a page to receive it
  • Make the stop() that every() and at() return actually stop the job
  • Hold event listeners for the length of a dispatch

• Stop the fan floor from believing its own writes
  • Stop handing the fans back to find out what macOS wants
  • Record why the fan floor uses the coarse thermal signal
  • Give the launcher a shadow it can actually cast
  • Round the launcher with squircles and line its edge

• Attribute Claude Code in commit messages
  • Focus the launcher search field on the launch-time show
  • Announce new plugins and say "Load", not "Reload"
  • Tell plugin agents to log, and how to read the log
  • Make hid.readInput wait on the interrupt pipe
  • Queue unread HID input reports so a reply cannot outrun the read
  • Document the new hid.readInput in macotron.d.ts
  • Make the settings window taller by default

• Let the community publish plugins with a GitHub topic
  • Tell people how to publish a community plugin
  • Settle on macotron-plugin-<name> for community repos
  • Put the version in the release run name
  • Say out loud that this is a beta
• Give the meetings menu a clock, a refresh, and a real join link

• Give the DMG a window worth opening
  • Fit the DMG window around the toolbar Tahoe will not hide
  • Ask tccd for the calendar it kept refusing to prompt for
  • Say that releases come from Actions now

• Build releases on GitHub, with provenance and an SBOM
  • Say why notarization refused instead of swallowing it
  • Take the notary key as a file or as base64
  • Show what the publish step can see
  • Trace the appcast script in CI, temporarily
  • Show why sign_update refused instead of eating the message

• Put the world clocks under the month buttons
  • Stop a reload from triggering the next one
  • Update Macotron from inside Macotron
